subject: Road to contract: security checkpoints and DPA timeline
messages:
From: Alex Torres <alex.torres@ledgerbank.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-20T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: initial: security inputs needed before procurement sync

Hi Neha,

Thanks again for the demo today — LedgerBank liked the throughput numbers and the model routing ideas. Procurement wants to pin a Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and a short list of security items that must be completed before we land on procurement terms.

High level ask: can you share a draft MAP that calls out: SOC 2 evidence handoff, SIG/CAIQ responses, our DPA redline window (we typically need 1 week for internal legal review), and a proposed data retention policy for logs and customer data? Jenna (cc) and I will map that to our procurement timeline.

Would appreciate a one-page MAP + attachments we can feed to internal security. Can we get this by EOD Friday (11/20 PST)?

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Torres
Director, Strategic Procurement
LedgerBank

[Attachment: procurement_requirements_ledgerbank.pdf (pdf)]

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Torres <alex.torres@ledgerbank.com>, Jenna Walsh <jenna.walsh@ledgerbank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-20T11:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: initial: security inputs needed before procurement sync

Alex / Jenna —

Thanks — attached is a concise MAP and supporting packets to start your security review. High-level items included:
- SOC 2: we will provide our latest Type II report and a SOC2 evidence index (list of artifacts, owners, and transfer method).
- SIG/CAIQ: we can provide completed sections and estimate a 3-business-day turnaround on the remaining control narratives.
- DPA: attaching our standard DPA + a redline option that narrows the retention window. Happy to negotiate specific clauses.
- Data retention: default 12 months for application logs; option to configure 30/90/365 per contract.

Proposed MAP milestones (draft):
1) 11/20: MAP + initial docs delivered (this email).
2) 11/23: security Q&A complete (SIG gaps closed or documented exceptions).
3) 11/24: legal redline exchange (DPA v2).
4) 11/30: final DPA signed + DocuSign to procurement.
5) 12/07: go/no-go — production access and onboarding window.

Attaching: redwood_map_v1.pdf, dpa_redline_v2.docx, soc2_evidence_index.csv, sig_caix_partial_responses.pdf

If the retention default doesn't work for you, propose the term you need and we'll flag for legal. Looping in Marissa and Karthik for any questions on the SOC2 artifacts and DPA clauses.

Cheers,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Sales Manager, Enterprise
Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192

Subject: Fwd: initial MAP + artifacts — quick security read

Looping in Laura for the DPA redline. Quick notes from security:
- SOC 2 evidence index looks complete for standard infra controls; will need owner confirmations for encryption-at-rest keys (KMS/HSM) and third-party vendor inventories.
- SIG: we only filled ~60% of CAIQ controls so need a 48–72 hour push to finish narratives if they request full completion.
- Retention: default 12 months OK for logging; if customer requires <90 days we typically need a product change request to truncate some cached telemetry.

Action items for legal: please review DPA redline v2 — primary negotiations expected around data deletion timelines and subprocessors clause.

-Karthik
Head of Security, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Road to contract: security checkpoints and DPA timeline

Neha — thanks for the fast turnaround. A couple of clarifying questions from our security desk (Samir cc):
1) For SOC 2 evidence transfer — can you provide a scoping statement that limits exported artifacts to LedgerBank-specific evidence (i.e., not full internal tickets)? We need to ensure we only receive customer-relevant artifacts.
2) SIG/CAIQ — is the 3-business-day estimate including internal review of vendor responses or is that purely Redwood's time to draft? If you can commit to completed narratives by 11/25, that helps our SOC reviewer schedule.
3) Data retention: LedgerBank's baseline requirement is 90 days for logs and a separate 7-year retention for transactional records in our custody model. Will Redwood support a split policy (configurable per data category)?

Also, our legal team will push a couple of DPA redline comments on the deletion clause; Jenna will share the annotated document.

Best,
Priya Ramanathan
Security Operations
LedgerBank

[Attachment: ledgerbank_security_req.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Ramanathan <priya.r@ledgerbank.com>, Alex Torres <alex.torres@ledgerbank.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-24T10:18:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Road to contract: security checkpoints and DPA timeline

Priya —

Thanks for the clear asks. Quick legal read:
- We can commit to a Ledger-scoped SOC 2 evidence handoff; we'll produce only artifacts that are directly LedgerBank-facing (audit reports, configuration snapshots, anonymized ticket summaries). We will not transfer full internal incident tickets without redaction.
- SIG/CAIQ: Redwood will deliver completed narratives by COB 11/25 (we'll prioritize controls Samir flags).
- Retention: Redwood supports configurable retention by data category. Our standard offer: logs (30/90/365), metadata benches (90/365), transactional records (configurable; default 7 years is OK but may incur additional storage costs). We propose the contract include a clause that Ledger chooses retention tiers per environment and agrees to the associated cost schedule.

On the DPA: we accept Jenna's high-level deletion ask but will propose a compromise on the deletion window for backups and snapshots (we require 60 days for safe-rollback). Please send annotated redline and we'll return a negotiated DPA within 3 business days.

-Laura Bennett
Sr. Counsel, Redwood Inference

[Attachment: dpa_response_summary.pdf (pdf)]

Subject: Final MAP & next steps for signature (timeline to close)

Team —

Thanks for the quick reviews and the annotated redlines (Jenna / Priya). Summary of agreed items and next steps to hit a target close by 12/1: 
- SIG/CAIQ: Redwood to complete remaining narratives and send full SIG bundle by 11/25 EOD. (Owner: Karthik)
- SOC 2 evidence: scoped handoff of Ledger-specific artifacts by 11/26 morning. (Owner: Vivek)
- DPA: Redwood will ingest Jenna's annotated redline and return a negotiated DPA by 11/27. We request Ledger's legal to sign or counter within 48 hours. (Owner: Laura)
- Retention: Ledger opts for logs = 90 days, transactional records = 7 years. We will reflect costs in the final contract appendix.
- DocuSign: I'll send the DocuSign envelope for the negotiated DPA + SOW on 11/28 if all approvals are in place.

If we all align to these milestones the go/no-go for production access can be 12/07 and procurement can finalize commercial terms alongside signature.
